qs.q: A 19-year-old man presents with an anterior mediastinal mass. Biopsy reveals large neoplastic cells with abundant clear cytoplasm and central nuclei, positive for placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP). Which characteristic genetic abnormality defines this germ cell tumor?
o: C. Deletion of the long arm of chromosome 13
B. Monosomy of chromosome 22 affecting NF2 locus
A. Isochromosome of the short arm of chromosome 12
D. Trisomy of chromosome 8 involving MYC gene
qs.e: Seminomas and other testicular germ cell tumors characteristically display an isochromosome of chromosome 12, i(12p).
